title: Graphical abstract

intent.message: The study links experimental warming to soil carbon loss through a measurable mechanism.

claims.statement: Experimental warming is linked to soil carbon loss.

expected_design_characteristics: One core message readable in a thumbnail-sized rendering
Minimal text with the takeaway understandable without a caption
Palette and shape language resolved from the manuscript style
A clear visual order from experiment motif to key result
known_failure_modes: Dense multi-panel content squeezed into one small image
Text that becomes unreadable at thumbnail size
Decorative icons competing with the scientific message
